title: Local sessions stop failing on the GitHub plugin's empty token
why: A mailaudit session's finding, Oct 26: the GitHub plugin sends 'Bearer ${GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN}' with the variable unset, so GitHub's MCP server refuses it on every local session.
note: Ruling, Oct 27 12:07 CDT (shiv, waiting page item 35): (b), try a token once on the Mac and see what it adds before choosing. Finding, Oct 27 12:09 CDT (local liaison): the GitHub plugin is not on the Mac at all (plugin list, MCP list and every repo's settings checked), so the empty-token failure is on Windows. Asked: the local liaison's thread, (a) test on Windows, (b) install the plugin on the Mac to test, or (c) turn it off on Windows; waiting-page item c87-token-make is withdrawn until then. Waits on: a local session. Checked claude-settings main 54be9f1: its enabledPlugins does not list a GitHub plugin. The fix lands in claude-settings so every machine gets it. Port: no; global settings install everywhere. Placed ahead of c54, after c47 (triage, Oct 26): both are local setup on your machines.
